plan.title: SRC-CUR-009 Savings in a second currency

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.

args.goal: On the RFQ create screen, ensure the line item is CYLINDER with variant CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB and Default Variant, set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Savings, choose Budget, leave the USD price empty on the multi-currency event, and submit or save the savings configuration until the screen visibly shows the refusal "Please enter price in USD"
